notes.title: A big update to version 1.1.1!
notes.notes:

notes.title: Update 1.0.9 is available!
notes.notes:
Greetings!
Update 1.0.9 is available!

* Added 8 music tracks!
* Fixed the incorrect operation of the "Sound" option. Now the sound is turned on / off in real time.
* Fixed platform exit beyond the monitor (virtual).
* Fixed small bugs on bonus levels.
* The problem with textures on the final video has been resolved.
* Changed the effect of missing some blocks.
* Added SSAO effect.
* Added effects for the death scene.

notes.title: A major update to version 1.0.4! Added achievements and many fixes
notes.notes:

* Corrected the name of the levels.
* Fixed incorrect work bonus, which reduces the platform.
* Fixed incorrect display of the menu item.
* Supplemented New Game + mode.
* Added effect on receipt of bonuses.
* Adjusted probability of a bonus, "Heart."
* Adjusted points system.
* Achievements added!
